title: Part Library search, filters, sorting and columns still work
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create two parts for this test with no manufacturer: part A in category A and part B in category B, with descriptions that sort A to Z with part A's first.
  • Give parts A and B part numbers that start with the same text, so one search lists both.
  • Make sure at least one manufacturer exists, manufacturer A.
  • Start on the Part Library page (Parts in the top bar, then Part Library in the left menu).
custom_steps:
1. Type the shared start of the part numbers in the Search box.
  2. Pick category A in the Category filter.
  3. Pick All categories in the Category filter.
  4. Pick manufacturer A in the Manufacturer filter.
  5. Pick All manufacturers in the Manufacturer filter.
  6. Click the Description column heading.
  7. Click the Description column heading again.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Parts A and B are listed (2 rows).
  • The columns are Description, Part Number, Tags, Category, Manufacturer, Measurement and Size.

Step 2:

  • Only part A is listed: part B, in category B, is left out.

Step 3:

  • Parts A and B are listed again.

Step 4:

  • Neither part is listed, because neither has a manufacturer: the Manufacturer filter narrows the list.

Step 5:

  • Parts A and B are listed again.

Step 6:

  • The rows are ordered by Description: part A above part B.

Step 7:

  • The order is reversed: part B above part A.
